concepts.gloss_en: The true leader (definite) — the archetypal leader of all Israel, explicitly identified with Moses / the encompassing spirit (ruach hakolel)

members.note: representative; definite 'THE true leader of all Israel' = bechinat Moshe, the generational archetype

concepts.gloss_en: A true leader (indefinite) — one who is like Moses and can apportion greatness to each; possibly generic rather than the single archetype

members.note: same Torah (lm2:72) and also glossed 'bechinat Moshe', but indefinite 'יש מנהיג אמתי' reads as generic; per rule 2 keep separate from definite form rather than silently merge

notes: Both forms occur in lm2:72 and both are equated with bechinat Moshe, so they very likely denote the same referent. However, per the binding rule on the definite article (archetype vs. any instance), the definite המנהיג האמתי and indefinite מנהיג אמתי are kept separate and flagged for human decision. Under-merge preferred.
